newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CIL takes stake in China property venture.
newsitem.headline: CIL takes stake in China property venture.

text.p: CIL Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to buy a 50 percent stake in a property joint venture in China's Guangxi province from third party Hillary Group Ltd for HK$30 million.
CIL said it would fund the deal from internal resources.

The only asset of joint venture firm Nanning Haiqi Real Estate Development Co Ltd is a piece of land covering a site area of 16,376 square metres zoned for residential and commercial use, the company said.
The site was a redevelopment project in the heart of the city of Nanning in Guangxi, it said.
The venture was 90 percent held by Hillary Group and 10 percent by Nanning City Housings Construction and Land Development Co Ltd prior to the deal.
CIL shares gained HK$0.02 to HK$0.78 in mid-morning trade.
